credits: Everything is Everything was Amit Varma and Ajay Shah’s weekly show, 128 episodes from June 2023 to December 2025. This edition is made from Episode 45. The moving pictures, stills and chapter cards are from its video; the chapter art is by Simahina. Every play button starts the video at the moment it was said. The articles and headlines were written by Claude, an AI model, from the episode’s machine-made transcript, and checked against it. Other photographs are from Wikimedia Commons: Thomas Sowell, 1964 (public domain); Adam Smith, the Muir portrait (public domain); Friedrich Hayek (Mises Institute, CC BY-SA 3.0); Milton Friedman, Bachrach Studios, 1986 (public domain); a Chicago soup kitchen, February 1931 (US National Archives, public domain).
